sources.snippet: Recent geometric foundation models (e.g., Metric3D, Depth Anything and UniDepth) have substantially improved monocular depth estimation (MDE) in both cross-scene generalization and metric-scale prediction, yet these gains have not translated to tiny models. sources.snippet: DepthART scales foundation monocular depth estimation to compact Small, Base, and Large models. The release supports both affine-invariant relative depth and camera-aware metric depth, with optimized inference paths for desktop NVIDIA GPUs and Jetson Orin NX.

sources.title: DepthART: Scaling Foundation Monocular Depth to Tiny Models
sources.snippet: We present DepthART, a tiny monocular depth model that transfers much of the generalization ability of foundation MDE models to deployment-oriented backbones, while supporting stable metric calibration through encoder-frozen camera-conditioned fine-tuning.
